items.title: Prepare realistic fixtures and evidence register

Record SHA/environment/scenario/result in a single evidence format
checks: Fixtures are unmistakably test-only
All 72 scenarios have a planned owner and appropriate environment

items.title: Repair baseline CI and choose the web/worker staging path

steps: Investigate GitHub Actions startup failures and Cloudflare deployment failure
Distinguish static coming-soon hosting from full web/worker/PostgreSQL hosting
Record environment requirements and O18 options
checks: Root cause and fix or precise external blocker documented
Required checks can execute on the chosen path; no deployment claim from configuration alone

items.title: Preserve canonical identity across verified wallet links
items.outcome: Changing a wallet or login method never gives another work slot or erases earned history.
steps: Extend existing account and wallet-link services around a stable participant
Reject conflicting provider subjects
Require proof/review for recovery and merges, preserving claims and capacity
checks: Second wallet uses the same participant and history
Merge cannot hide two active engagements

items.title: Verify one-use wallet sign-in and account-link intent
items.outcome: A relayed or replayed signature cannot authenticate the wrong account or origin.
steps: Bind nonce/domain/URI/network/expiry/link intent
Verify message and signature server-side
Atomically consume the challenge and rotate safe session credentials
checks: Replay, changed domain, expiry and wrong intent fail
No key/secret appears in logs

items.title: Build beginner and experienced Raider onboarding

steps: Collect work interests and timezone
Explain evidence, confidentiality, review/payment and one-active rule
Provide starter tasks or relevant portfolio/trial path; verify payout destination before paid commitment
checks: Orientation creates no fabricated verified rank
Both user types reach an appropriate next action

Implement founder and delegated field permissions
Add audited project-admin actions and ownership-change process
Support founder-approved public project/progress updates where selected, keeping private roadmap/configuration fields out of public projections.

Treasury/dispute authority is separate from profile administration

Handle revoked authority, conflicts and token migration without selling clean history

Existing-project onboarding differs from a new launch

items.title: Observe holder eligibility without permission shortcuts

steps: Aggregate supported token-account balances by exact asset
Store time/slot/finality/provider freshness
Keep public association opt-in and unknown/stale state on RPC failure
checks: Holder cannot administer Guild or download private code
Token sale cannot delete work or claims

One verified frontend skill cannot satisfy Solana requirements

items.title: Define immutable Raid terms and publication checks

checks: Suggestion can be accepted/edited before terms acceptance

checks: Wizard uses server-derived validity/funding state

items.title: Implement idempotent commands with audit and outbox
items.outcome: Retrying a business action cannot silently create duplicate work, claims or history.

Reject same key with changed payload
Commit state, audit and outbox together; deduplicate incoming events
checks: Same logical command has one business outcome
Different payload returns an explicit conflict

items.title: Enforce atomic one-engagement capacity and slot vacancy

Use stable locks and whole-transaction retry
Reserve engagement, accepted terms and audit/outbox atomically
checks: Exactly one competing accept succeeds
No orphan engagement, extra outbox effect or double-filled slot

items.title: Route applications, offers and instant acceptance through one command

checks: Stale offer cannot acquire busy participant
Closed application paths stop consuming cap
Paid public work cannot start while binding is pending

Handle unauthenticated, denied, busy, expired, stale and retry states
checks: UI never grants authority from client eligibility boolean

items.title: Accept versioned submissions and criterion-based review

Authorize member submit and reviewer accept/revise/dispute commands
Scope revision to original criteria and bounded deadlines
checks: Unknown or mismatched submission version cannot be approved
Review and work/payment states stay separate

items.title: Close work finitely while preserving claims and newer capacity

Close work and release matching participant+engagement atomically
Preserve unpaid claims/evidence and require consent/capacity to reopen
checks: Late cleanup cannot release a newer job
Payment pending does not consume terminal work capacity

items.title: Support consented work amendments and member replacement contracts

Verify additional funding and capacity when required
Retain original accepted history and clear amendment audit
checks: Unilateral founder/admin/default changes rejected
Replacement records new obligation rather than deleting old contribution

Route and authorities match the recorded decision

Resume same mint/semantic intent without duplicating successful steps
checks: Draft and intent survive wallet rejection
Submitted signature is not shown as verified LIVE

items.title: Verify launch artifacts and activate the right Guild relationship

Store observation references and exact Guild linkage
Reconcile late success and interrupted multi-step state
checks: Wrong mint/network/authority cannot activate Guild
Crash after broadcast does not create another launch

items.title: Implement exact asset registry and bounded amount arithmetic
items.outcome: The reward amount identifies the actual asset and never loses precision.
steps: Key assets by network/mint/program and native/token kind
Version supported decimals/extensions/authority policy separately
Use bounded integer parsing/allocation/rounding and JSON decimal strings
checks: Same ticker or wrong network cannot substitute
Policy version cannot duplicate spendable balance

items.title: Prove selected escrow authority and protocol capability
items.outcome: The payment mechanism protects committed rewards and constrains who may move them.
steps: Compare existing custody to O05 authority model
Record permitted signers/beneficiaries/upgrade and termination paths
Demonstrate binding/refund/claim replay protection in selected environment
checks: Founder cannot refund bound work unilaterally
No model/admin generic arbitrary-withdrawal power

items.title: Verify deposits and reserve each promised obligation once
items.outcome: A client signature cannot invent funds or promise the same deposit to several workers.

Reserve distinct slot/entry/award liabilities and all bundle legs
checks: Only fully verified promised legs permit acceptance

items.title: Bind accepted terms before work and resource readiness
items.outcome: No commissioned work starts before verified funding binding and required resources.
